# Jetpack Comedy

> Jetpack Comedy is a stand-up comedy show in West Hollywood, Los Angeles: every Friday since 2012, 6–8 handpicked comedians perform in the 70-seat back room of Bar Lubitsch.

## The show

- What: handpicked stand-up comedy, 6–8 comedians a night
- When: every Friday. Doors 8pm, show 8:30pm
- Where: the back room of Bar Lubitsch, 7702 Santa Monica Blvd, West Hollywood, Los Angeles, CA 90046
- Price: $20. No drink minimum
- Age: 21+
- Room: 70 seats
- Running since: 2012
- Rating: 4.9 on Google from 116 reviews
- Tickets: [Jetpack Comedy on Micdrop](https://get-micdrop.com/o/1-jetpack-comedy)
- Website: [jetpackcomedy.com](https://jetpackcomedy.com/)
- Email: shows@jetpackcomedy.com

## Know before you go

- Is there an age requirement? Yes. The venue serves alcohol, so there is a strict 21+ age requirement.
- Is there a drink minimum? No, there is not a drink minimum, but it would be great to get a drink to support Bar Lubitsch.
- If the show is sold out, will you have tickets at the door? No. Shows sell out often, so get tickets online in advance. If the show is listed as Sold Out on the web, there are no extra tickets at the door.
- Is the venue wheelchair accessible? Yes.
- What's up with parking? Lots of free parking on Santa Monica Blvd and the surrounding streets, or there is a paid lot at the corner of Spaulding.

## Comedians who have played Jetpack

James Adomian, Aisha Alfa, Maria Bamford, J.B. Ball, Matt Besser, Kelsey Cook, Kiran Deol, Francesca Fiorentini, Garfunkel and Oates, Laurie Kilmartin, Dan Levy, Joe Mande, Demetri Martin, Kevin Nealon, Bob Odenkirk, Ryan O'Flanagan, Atsuko Okatsuka, Rachel Scanlon, Usama Siddiquee, Sarah Silverman, The Sklar Brothers, Moses Storm, Nina Tarr, Chinedu Unaka, Sheng Wang, Will Weldon, Harland Williams.
